packageRules.description: Keep global.json in step with the published SDK container images so Docker builds do not fail on an SDK that is not yet in the image.
Bump the .NET SDK, the setup-dotnet version and the Docker build stage together. If the Dockerfile pin and global.json diverge, dotnet restore fails inside the image (see #603).
Review Compose image updates manually and retain readable version tags.
The image renderer and media server tags are owned by their own release workflows. Do not look them up or update them from this repository.
PostgreSQL major upgrades need an explicit migration decision.
prBodyNotes: PostgreSQL major upgrades require a tested data migration. Review the volume/PGDATA layout before deploying; changing the image tag alone does not upgrade an existing database.
